messages:
anna_cs: Heads-up — AcmeHealth hit truncated streaming output in prod after they upgraded billing plan while an SSE stream was active. Client sees incomplete JSON (parse error) and no finish_reason. They say it used to be transient but now reproducible.

sam_sre: Oof. Do we have a request_id or user token so we can correlate logs? Edge/proxy in front?

anna_cs: request_id: r-0a1b2c3d. Region: eu-west-1. They reported it happened exactly when billing changed from trial->paid and their auth token rotated (short-lived). Using our hosted API (SSE).

michael_eng: Got it. Quick checklist: 1) confirm server emitted final chunk (finish event) 2) confirm proxy didn't cut connection mid-chunk 3) check resume headers on reconnect. I pulled partial logs: server wrote: "stream_end: finish_reason=null, final_event_skipped=true" for r-0a1b2c3d.

charlie_infra: That log line screams "we never sent the terminal SSE frame" not a client parse issue. Can you paste the curl/+headers repro?

anna_cs: Repro attached from customer (sanitized):
```bash
# reproduce (customer):
curl -v -N \\\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=redwood-large\\\" \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>' \\
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \\
  -H 'Connection: keep-alive'
```
They say: if they call, then immediately perform billing upgrade via dashboard (causes a 302 at our billing gateway and a token rotate webhook), the client eventually reconnects and the final JSON is missing from the first stream.

sam_sre: Can you reproduce in staging with a scripted token rotation? If connection is kept alive while the token rotates, some proxies might close the TCP connection (302/302 chain) and client resumes but misses the last chunk. Also check if finish_reason field is only added by the post-send step which may be gated on a billing webhook callback.

michael_eng: Reproduction steps we used locally (node):
```js
const res = await fetch(streamUrl, {headers:{Authorization:token, Accept:'text/event-stream'}});
res.body.on('data', chunk => console.log('chunk', chunk.toString()));
// after X ms trigger billing-sim -> rotate token
```
Observed: server emitted JSON object closing brace and then a short delay, then nothing. No final SSE event ("event: done\n:data {...}\n\n").

charlie_infra: Edge note: our edge layer (fastly/nginx) has a 30s inactive timeout for backend keepalive. During billing redirect/rotate we see TCP RST in some flows. Also one config risk: when auth changes mid-stream we currently perform a lightweight revalidation that can call into billing service and stall the response path. If billing service takes >5s we may drop final flush.

anna_cs: Customer is on a mission-critical flow; they're seeing this in production and it's blocking. They reported parse failure in their client logs: "Unexpected end of JSON input".

michael_eng: Temporary mitigations for customer: 1) set client to treat streams as append-only (tolerate final chunk missing and then re-request with resume header) 2) ask them to avoid billing action during active long-lived streams 3) server-side fix: ensure terminal SSE event is flushed before any auth/billing operation that could tear down connection.

sam_sre: I'll open INF ticket and add traces. Deploy-bot: posting recent deploys around time 4112233440.
\
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-02-18T09:10Z -> service/streams v3.14.2 (sha: a1b2c3). No restarts in that window.

sam_sre: Created INF-7892, assigned to charlie_infra + michael_eng. Priority: P1 for AcmeHealth escalations. Added request_id and sample curl.

charlie_infra: Immediate infra action: increase edge keepalive to 60s for streaming routes and add a server-side flush before billing webhook call. I'll roll a canary to staging and run the reproduce script with simulated billing webhook delay.

michael_eng: I'll add a small change to ensure we emit a terminal SSE event (with finish_reason) and a hard flush (tcp push) before triggering any operations that could close the connection. Patch PR: #1456.

anna_cs: Thanks team. I told AcmeHealth we'll do a hotfix and follow up within 4 hours. I'll add them to the incident DM and collect their logs for INF-7892. :thumbsup:

sam_sre: Follow-up checklist: 1) confirm canary passes in staging with 10 runs 2) patch to prod behind a quick feature flag 3) notify customer and provide client-side resume guidance.

michael_eng: Noting root cause candidate: token rotation + billing webhook induced blocking path that prevents final SSE flush -> truncated final chunk and finish_reason omitted. Concrete fix: flush terminal SSE + decouple billing webhook sync path.

charlie_infra: Will update INF-7892 with timeline.

anna_cs: Closing thread here; will post updates in INF-7892.
